source_policy: The first reference is the locked natural-placement candidate. Remaining references are physical product authority. Preserve every pixel outside the named garment regions as closely as the editor permits.
workflow: verify every reference path and SHA-256
visualize the candidate and product authority
apply only the named garment-surface corrections
compare output against the locked candidate and product authority
hold for founder approval before wiring

Reconstruct the crewneck mark as the exact subtle black-on-black embossed relief visible in Image 2, not white ink, not embroidery and not a new rose drawing. Reconstruct the jogger mark as the exact small molded silicone applique visible in Image 3. Keep their real scale, placement, relief and low-contrast material response. Preserve the model, pose, face, silhouette, garment construction, wall statue, bridge, moon, lighting, wet floor, shadows, reflections, camera and all other pixels. No extra logo, text, product or watermark. Founder-review candidate only.
